address: Çırağan Caddesi No:32, Beşiktaş, Istanbul, 34349, Türkiye
bio: At Tuğra, diners are made to feel like royalty. Marble columns frame a view of the glimmering Bosphorus. Here, you can bask in the historical splendour of the magnificent Çırağan Palace – the opulence never fails to impress. And the terrace is simply breathtaking! The impeccable service leaves you wanting for nothing. As for the food, Ottoman culinary heritage goes hand in hand with haute cuisine, with traditional flavours elevated by the chef's expert touch and elegant plating. For instance, tender beef fillet is paired with a robust brown jus and clever accompaniments such as a quenelle of fermented milk, mashed potatoes with pine nuts and an exquisite onion confit – a fascinating combination.
